notes: Redesigned Downloads actions: each file now shows one clear state-aware action plus a clean three-dot menu instead of a row of ambiguous icon-only buttons.
Moved remove, queue ordering, copy-link, cancel and other secondary actions into styled overflow menus; batch cards now use the same interaction pattern.
Added a dedicated high-contrast small Windows icon for taskbar, tray and title bar, while keeping the full mascot artwork for the in-app brand and splash screen.
